overall_strategy: AJ is a 7-month-old, high-energy 40 lb pug (strong chewer) in an apartment with large yard access and heat/allergy considerations. At Journey Month 3 we prioritize consistent consumables on autoship (primary kibble, multiple soft training treats, grooming wipes, dental paste, paw wax and pheromone refills) to support nutrition, daily training and seasonal health (allergens/heat). Setup and durable items (bowls, cooling vest, travel bottle, no‑pull harness, heavy-duty chews, enrichment puzzles, deshedding tool, slow feeder, flirt pole, fetch toys, cooling mat, comfort blanket) are recommended as one-time purchases to establish a safe, enriched environment. Frequency math is tailored to AJ’s weight/activity (food ≈ 3.5 cups/day → ~30‑lb bag every ~5 weeks) and daily routines (wipes after outings, many training treats daily, monthly pheromone refills). Adjust autoship cadences seasonally (e.g., more cooling/pupsicle items in heat, increase wipes/diffuser during allergy/noise periods) and re-evaluate chew/toy replacement rate as you monitor AJ’s actual wear.
